stage0050a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...The end of human history...
　To dismiss it as nonsense, that man
　$$アドヴェント$$ spoke with utter conviction」

stage0050a_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Too heavy a statement to just laugh off」

stage0050a_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The position he gave,
　N23-32, E161-22,
　is unremarkable open ocean on any map」

stage0050a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$オットー$$
「Something vital, hidden either on
　that ocean's surface, or its depths...」

stage0050a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What's Captain Testarossa's take on this?」

stage0050a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I have no idea what's there.
　But...」

stage0050a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...The end of human history...
　I think I know what that means」

stage0050a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That matter is still under investigation,
　so I can't discuss it here」

stage0050a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But I don't think his words, coming
　at this moment, are unrelated to it」

stage0050a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So you believe an investigation is needed?」

stage0050a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$かなめ$$, what do you think?」

stage0050a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh...!?
　Why ask me, of all people...!?」

stage0050a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We've already been briefed that you
　are a 《$$ウィスパード$$》」

stage0050a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So we'd like to hear your view too.
　We won't hold you responsible, of course」

stage0050a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... I'm not really sure, but I think
　we should look into what we don't know」

stage0050a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If we go and find nothing there, we can
　just call it a bad joke and relax」

stage0050a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Then, $c, all ships will head
　for N23-32, E161-22...
　the tentative Point X」

stage0050a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「My apologies, but the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$
　has taken heavy damage from consecutive
　battles, so we will return to 《$$メリダ島$$》」

stage0050a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$かなめ$$, please come with me as well,
　and we'll send you to Japan from there」

stage0050a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「About that...
　could I go with $c instead?」

stage0050a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I mean... school's on summer break too,
　and hearing about the end of human
　history, I can't help but worry...」

stage0050a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Is $$かなめ$$'s inspiration
　sensing something...?）

stage0050a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ah...! Just so you know,
　I'm not trying to steal a march
　on you or anything...!」

stage0050a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I'm not thinking about anything like that!」

stage0050a_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「S-sorry...! It's nothing,
　just between us...!」

stage0050a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that no good, $$テッサ$$...?」

stage0050a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Understood. In that case,
　please investigate the site
　in my place」

stage0050a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If you come across the word '$$スフィア$$',
　please gather all the information you can」

stage0050a_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「What in the world is that?」

stage0050a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Someone asked me to look into it,
　but even I don't know if it truly exists」

stage0050a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ブライト$$
「And who might that be?」

stage0050a_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Those who were part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$
　should know her: Dr. $$トライア・スコート$$」

stage0050a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Doctor Fox, the 《$$次元獣$$》 authority」

stage0050a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Her advice was a great help fighting
　$$次元獣$$ in the $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$」

stage0050a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now that the $$次元獣$$ attacks have ceased,
　I hear she's studying hyperspace physics...」

stage0050a_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That word, $$スフィア$$, from before,
　came from Dr. $$トライア$$ herself」

stage0050a_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Though the word came from a flash
　of intuition on the doctor's part,
　so even she doesn't fully grasp it...」

stage0050a_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Feels like I've heard it before,
　or maybe not...）

stage0050a_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. We'll contact you
　as soon as we learn anything」

stage0050a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, I appreciate it.
　...$$かなめ$$, please take care too」

stage0050a_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. Thanks for everything, $$テッサ$$」

stage0050a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain Testarossa, you take care too.
　I'm grateful for your help with
　the overhaul of our ships」

stage0050a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As for what I know about the coming end,
　I intend to tell you once your
　investigation is complete」

stage0050a_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Good grief...
　I'm already dreading coming back」

stage0050a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ブライト$$
「You'd best not joke around, Captain $$オットー$$.
　First, we need to make it back safely
　to see Captain Testarossa again」

stage0050a_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$オットー$$
「Let's not scare each other, Commander」

stage0050a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Not entirely a joke, either.
　After all, where we're headed now
　is a clue to humanity's end」

stage0050a_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
（What's this... this strange unease...
　I wonder what's waiting for us
　at N23-32, E161-22...）

stage0050a_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$葵$$
「So hot...!
　My blood's on fire, all through me!」

stage0050a_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$不動$$
「And water mingles, and becomes one」

stage0050a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シモン$$
「This sky...!
　Same color as when I first reached
　the surface...!」

stage0050a_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's right...!
　I am... my drill spins, calling the wind,
　which swirls and reaches for the heavens!」

stage0050a_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シモン$$
「And someday, it will!
　Surpass even the light of heaven!!」

stage0050a_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Mankind grasped civilization...
　Was that the fire of Prometheus...?」

stage0050a_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But because of it, we expanded our world,
　making even cold, dark space our home...
　and found new possibilities...」

stage0050a_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What lies beyond...!
　Tell me, $$ララァ$$!!」

stage0050a_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$n
「Everyone, where are you!?
　Miss $$スズネ$$, please answer me!!」
